summary: Added cached, non-mutating authentication preflight checks for every configured CLI agent, with selector fallback, structured failure logging, dashboard visibility, and coverage for auth failure modes. The implementation is committed on this branch; focused validation passes, while the full .NET suite retains unrelated Windows-only baseline failures.
risks: The full dotnet test command has seven unrelated baseline failures in this Windows worktree: one CRLF-sensitive RepositoryBootstrapTests assertion and six ProcessRunnerTests that invoke the Unix-only sh executable; all task-specific tests pass.

Authentication probes depend on each configured CLI's existing local session and never perform login or credential refresh; the frontend production build requires network access for the repository's existing Google Font import.
